name: Grade 8 IT Practice: April Week 6 - AI and Responsible Remix
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: Software that can do tasks that seem intelligent.
words.example: The AI tool suggested image ideas for the campaign.

words.definition: A type of AI that improves using data examples.
words.example: Machine learning improved after the model studied more examples.

words.definition: Facts or values that can be used or studied.
words.example: The class used data examples to compare correct and incorrect results.

words.definition: Using examples to teach a model.
words.example: Training gave the model examples before testing it.

words.definition: Trying something to see if it works.
words.example: Testing checked whether the model made a reasonable prediction.

words.definition: A guess or result made by a model.
words.example: The prediction guessed which category the example belonged to.

words.definition: A simple version or representation of something.
words.example: The model gave different results when the training data changed.

words.definition: Something that makes results less complete or certain.
words.example: One limitation was that the model confused similar images.
